title: Module pullback and pushforward adjunction on arbitrary ringed topoi
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be sites small relative to the universe of the module sheaves, with sheaves of commutative rings $R,S$, and let $u:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal D)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal C)$ be a morphism of topoi, an adjunction $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits, equipped with a ring map $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. On module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] put $u^*M=S\otimes_{u^{-1}R}u^{-1}M$ [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. For an $S$-module sheaf $H$, give $u_*H$ its $R$-module structure via the adjunct $R\to u_*S$ of $c$. There are canonical bijections $\operatorname{Hom}_S(u^*M,H)\cong\operatorname{Hom}_R(M,u_*H)$, natural in $M,H$. Thus the displayed tensor-formula pullback is left adjoint to this module pushforward.
